QF.id: Issue Management - General Obligations and Due Diligence_22

question.text: What must the lead manager submit to SEBI regarding news reports published between the filing of the offer document and issue closure?

answer.text: A compilation of all news reports with annotations identifying factual errors
A rebuttal document correcting any misleading news coverage
A compliance certificate certifying that the news reports are in compliance with SEBI regulations
A request for SEBI to issue directions to media outlets publishing non-compliant reports

explanation.text: The Logic: The lead manager must submit a compliance certificate to SEBI for the period from filing of the draft offer document or draft letter of offer to issue closure, in respect of news reports appearing in the specified categories of newspapers and media groups. The Trap: 'Compilation with annotations' and 'rebuttal document' sound like proactive monitoring outputs, but the specific regulatory requirement is a compliance certificate covering the prescribed period and media categories — not a content-by-content rebuttal or annotated compilation. Note: Maintain an internal log of news coverage across the covered media categories so the compliance certificate can be supported with evidence on file.
